summary: Independently re-verified the v2.9.3 hotfix/auth-routing backend contract with 23 pytest cases mapped 1:1 to the 15 verification IDs. All 15 verifications PASS against a fresh `arbicore_x_hotfix_test` Mongo db and a locally-launched uvicorn (127.0.0.1:8001). Release is safe to push.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5060 lines — well above the 700-line threshold. Recommend continuing the Tree-B extraction started in v2.9.3 (auth handlers already removed; next candidates: safety, execution, dashboard routers).
routes/auth.py `refresh` endpoint issues a new access_token but does NOT rotate the refresh_token. If the desired behavior is refresh-token rotation on use, this is a gap; if not, ignore.

services/auth.py `create_access_token` is deterministic within the same second (identical payload+exp truncated to seconds → identical JWT). Not a security bug, but E2E tests that assert 'new token != old token' will be flaky within a single second window. Consider adding a `jti` claim for uniqueness.

reset_admin.py `_wipe(...)` with `--dry-run` prints the current count but returns the value from `_count`. When the count call errors it returns -1 which is then reported as 'would delete -1 documents'. Minor UX polish; not a functional issue.

arbicore/auth/__init__.py still exists and is imported at boot even though the /api/auth/{login,logout,me,diagnostics} handlers were removed. The module is only used now for `_resolve_current_user` bearer fallback and (optionally) seed. Consider deleting the seed path entirely in v2.10.x since it wrote to a collection nothing else reads.
test_credentials: username=admin, password=testtest123 (setup) → newnewpass456 (after V8 change-password). Fresh Mongo db `arbicore_x_hotfix_test` on mongodb://localhost:27017. JWT_SECRET taken from /app/app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: V11 fixtures insert placeholder docs (`reset_dummy`, `legacy_dummy`) then delete via reset_admin.py. V13 second-boot test launches a scratch uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8002 with ARBICORE_LEGACY_AUTH_SEED=1 to prove the seed gate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend was launched manually with `cd /app/app/backend && python -m uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001` (logs → /tmp/backend.log). Supervisor's built-in `backend` unit points at /app/backend (does not exist in this repo layout) so it stays FATAL — that is expected here; do NOT try to fix the supervisor config. pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; the new test file has cross-class shared Mongo state, so it MUST be run serially: `pytest tests/test_auth_hotfix_v293.py -p no:xdist --override-ini='addopts='`. Running under xdist as-is will cause false failures (documented in the run history: V5/V6/V11 collided when 'admin' was inserted by V11 while V5 tried to login).
